notes: Fixes licence activation on Macs without Homebrew. Earlier versions could not verify the licence server's security certificate on a standard Mac, so entering a valid key was reported as "not accepted by Dodo". This build carries its own certificate bundle, activation works on any Mac, and a temporary licence-server outage is retried instead of being reported as a bad key. The same certificate bundle is now used when Docket crawls HTTPS sites, so audits no longer report broken certificates on sites whose certificates are fine.
